combinedOrientationCandidate.multiSourceGuard: applyBoundaryAnchoredOrientation returns map unchanged when !isMultiSourceMap(map) -> standalone unaffected
combinedOrientationCandidate.appliedOnceGuard: applyOrientationCandidateIfNeeded returns map when map.boundaryAnchoredOrientationActive && map.combinedCoordinateFrame === 'combinedPlaced'

combinedVisibleLaneProjectionCandidate.parsedBy: parseCombinedVisibleLaneProjectionCandidate(search) in lib/combined_visible_lane_projection.js (canonical) + public mirror; render.js constructor also reads the raw param
combinedVisibleLaneProjectionCandidate.guards: isCandidateEligible requires map.boundaryAnchoredOrientationActive && map.isMultiSource && map.sourceTransformByFile && mirrorChecked !== false -> standalone unaffected
combinedVisibleLaneProjectionCandidate.appliedOnceGuard: projectCombinedSourceLanePoint returns alreadyApplied when point.visibleLaneProjectionApplied === true or placed coords already present

urlPriority: Both selections are read from window.location.search on each build/draw; URL values override the promoted defaults.
whyCandidateCorrectsSeg2: The boundary-anchored orientation places each source file's canonical geometry into one combined frame (sourceHash correction + rotation + translation) and the combined visible-lane projection draws the point-accumulated dots in that same combinedPlaced frame, so the Seg2 lane dots follow the road rather than the un-corrected per-file placement.
whyPlainDidNot: With the candidate absent, the orientation was not applied (parse returned null) and the combined visible-lane projection was disabled, so Seg2 retained its incorrect original right curve.
failureCause: default-selection only; the transform algorithms are unchanged
